components.name: Exact open-closed integer quotient-window transport and shell separation
components.project_addition: Lift the exact cofactor-window arithmetic discovered in P017 L054 back into P007/A0. For any integer source interval (A,B] and positive factor d, the stripped quotient states are exactly [Q_d(A)+1,Q_d(B)]; two factor windows are strictly ordered exactly when Q_e(B)<=Q_d(A), with dB<=eA as a pure-integer sufficient condition and Q_d(A)-Q_e(B) as the exact unused quotient gap. The P017 consecutive-square prime-shell separation is then a specialization. Floor division and interval arithmetic are prior art; historical novelty of the packaging and application remains unverified.
